saveExtremes.Name: Natural 20s and 1s on saves against damage
saveExtremes.Hint: A natural 20 on a saving throw takes no damage. A natural 1 takes the most damage the dice could roll, with no reduction for the save. Resistance, vulnerability and immunity still apply.

acCap.Name: Armor Class cap
acCap.Hint: No creature's Armor Class goes above this, however it is worked out. 0 switches the cap off.

gearBonusesHighestOnly.Name: Gear bonuses don't stack
gearBonusesHighestOnly.Hint: When several items give a bonus to attack rolls or to saving throws, only the highest counts. A magic weapon's own +X is compared with gear bonuses to that attack. Bonuses from spells and features, penalties and dice bonuses still stack.

halfHitPoints.Name: Half-die hit points
halfHitPoints.Hint: When hit points are rolled at level up, half the hit die is fixed and the other half is rolled: a d6 rolls 1d3 + 3, a d8 1d4 + 4, a d10 1d5 + 5 and a d12 1d6 + 6. The Constitution modifier is still added.

emanationsOncePerRound.Name: Emanations once per round
emanationsOncePerRound.Hint: A spell emanation such as Spirit Guardians affects a creature at most once per round, not once per turn. Needs Primal Auras 1.3.0 or later; works on aura effects marked "once per turn".

emanationScope.Name: Which auras are once per round
emanationScope.Hint: Spell auras are auras on a spell, or named after a spell the caster has (like the Spirit Guardians preset). All auras makes every once-per-turn aura effect once per round.

mvpPip.Name: MVP pip
mvpPip.Hint: A second pip beside the Inspiration marker on character sheets, for MVP. Click it to light it or spend it.

quickRest.Name: Quick Break rest
quickRest.Hint: A Quick Break button beside the short and long rests: 10 minutes, one Hit Die, and nothing else recovers.

MVP.Lit: MVP: lit. Click to spend it.
MVP.Unlit: MVP: not lit. Click to light it.

QuickRest.Label: Quick Break
QuickRest.Hint: Take a 10 minute breather. You can spend one Hit Die; nothing else recovers.
QuickRest.OneDie: One Hit Die per Quick Break.
QuickRest.Rolled: You've spent your Hit Die for this Quick Break.
QuickRest.Result: {name} takes a Quick Break and regains {health}.
